items.information: Mind Games 2017 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill, but there is a competitor limit of 60 people (FMC will have a limit of 25 competitors), due to venue constraints. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

You can check out booking.com or airbnb.com for information about hotels and other places to stay in over night. Our goal with the schedule is to have events that were not held at Icelandic nationals. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Þetta mót verður haldið 6. júni og er það fyrsta mótið á Heimaey frá upphafi! Til þess að komast á eyjuna þarft þú að fara með ferjunni Herjólfi. Hann er staðsettur í Landeyjahöfn og er u.þ.b. tveggja klukkustunda keyrsla frá Reykjavík til Landeyjahafnar. Hægt er að taka strætó á milli staða. Hér getur þú pantað miða í Herjólf - https://www.saeferdir.is/ferdir-i-bodi/vestmannaeyjar/ Þú getur kíkt á booking.com / airbnb.com fyrir upplýsingar um hótel eða aðra gistingu í Vestmannaeyjum.

items.name: Swisscubing Better Be Quick 2018
items.information: Pendant la pause de midi, nous allons faire des grillades. Nous comptons donc sur tous les compétiteurs d'apporter des salades, viandes ou autre (le top étant des spécialités de sa propre région) afin de le partager avec les autres compétiteurs. During lunch time we will do a big BBQ, so we hope that everyone will bring some salads, meat and other meals (the best option would be to bring specialities from your own region) in aim to share it with everyone. Während der Mittagspause werden wir grillieren. Darum hoffen wir dass alle Teilnehmer etwas zu essen mitbringen (Salat, Fleisch, Spezialität von zuhause) um es mit den anderen zu Teilen. Mentre la pausa di mezzogiorno faremo una grigliata. Speriamo che tutti porteranno delle insalate, della carne o altre cose (il meglio sono le specialità del vostro paese) da condividere con i altri concorrenti.

Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. Entry is free for spectators, no registration required. Competitors must register and pay a registration fee, see the registration page for more details. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. items.information: Quinnipiac University will host its first official WCA competition this September! We are planning a competition with a relaxed but engaging and social atmosphere, that will hopefully give the Connecticut cubing community a chance to connect. The theme of this competition is breadth rather than depth. Our events will sample a variety of puzzle categories, from larger cubes (4x4) and different solving approaches (One-Handed, Blindfolded, Fewest Moves), to puzzles of different shapes (Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1). All events except the traditional 3x3 speedsolve will be single rounds; Fewest Moves in particular will consist of **one** hour-long attempt. Family, friends, and guests are welcome, but we ask competitors to let us know the number of people attending on their registration forms. The parking lot in front of the venue should be free of charge, but there are no guarantees if that particular lot reaches capacity. We look forward to seeing you in September!

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2018 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In Addition New Zealand Nationals 2018 will crown the National Champions in 17 events of the World Cube Associations 18 over the course of 3 days.

items.name: Fewest Moves Christmas 2018
items.information: Den eneste disciplin der vil blive afholdt til denne konkurrence er 3x3x3 i Færrest Træk! Der vil være pauser mellem de tre forsøg, hvor vi kan have noget julesjov. Vi vil lave pakkeleg, hvor det er muligt at deltage, hvis man medbringer en lille gave. Efter konkurrencen vil det være muligt at blive og hygge til klokken 20:00. Frokost og julesnacks vil blive serveret i løbet af dagen og er en del af detagergebyret. Det vil også være muligt at få aftensmad, men det vil koste ekstra :) ____ The only event which will be held at this competition is 3x3x3 Fewest Moves! There will be breaks between the attempts where we can have some Christmas fun. One of these activities will be "Pakkeleg" where you can bring a small gift if you wish to participate. After the competition it will be possible to stay for hygge until 20:00. Lunch and Christmas snacks will be provided in the registration fee. Dinner is optional and will cost extra :)

items.name: Welcome to 2019
items.information: With the competition happening over New Years, we strongly recommend that you sleep at the hotel that the competition is located in. This is due to the fact that New Years is one of the riskiest nights in regards to drunk driving. You can either get yourself a private room or split the room with other competitors. For more information on the rooms we have reserved for competitors and private rooms, please refer to the "[Hotel Information + FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Welcometo2019#8093-hotel-information-faq)" Tab.
